what_implemented: A PURE, INERT design-only contract for immutable evidence-store + resolver readiness (Stage 6 = Gate 6, FUT-3, the third future gate). It produces an EV-06 readiness record that READIES the ALREADY-IMPLEMENTED §9 content-addressed immutable resolver (design/hermes_fw08_content_resolution_v1) and BINDS readiness to EV-04 (build-producer registration) and EV-05 (OCI-inspection-producer registration) from FUT-2. It authorises NO store mutation.

EvidenceStoreReadinessRecord frozen dataclass (EV-06): binds contract_version, lifecycle_stage(6), fut('FUT-3'), readiness_record_id, ev04_reference, ev05_reference, resolver_contract_reference, resolver_identity_reference, store_policy_reference, digest_algorithm('sha256'), immutable_storage_id, storage_version_scheme, supported_evidence_classes, canonical_serialisation_reference, max_object_size_policy_reference, fail_closed_policy_reference, creation/validity UTC, revocation_state, synthetic_or_real_classification, readiness_status, fault_code, provenance, evidence_references, created_by, a readiness_digest and a module-issuer readiness_seal. References + policy tokens + status ONLY; NO endpoint/bucket/credential/host-path/raw-key fields.

validate_resolver_readiness (§B): DELEGATES to §9 require_content_resolver(resolver, real_mode=real_mode) and surfaces CR-RESOLVER-MISSING / CR-RESOLVER-UNTRUSTED / CR-SYNTHETIC-IN-REAL-MODE verbatim; additionally requires resolver_identity_reference present + canonical, digest_algorithm=='sha256' (else ES-DIGEST-ALGORITHM-UNSUPPORTED), immutable_storage_id + storage_version_scheme present (else ES-MUTABLE-STORAGE-UNREADY). No raw-dict / local-file / caller-provided-evidence-and-resolver acceptance path (structurally impossible; asserted via tests).

validate_immutability (§C): requires immutable_storage_id + a resolved storage_version, verifies the resolved evidence's own self-digest recomputes (ES-DIGEST-MUTATED), and DELEGATES resolution to §9 resolve_and_verify — surfacing CR-MUTABLE-REFERENCE / CR-REFERENCE-CONTENT-MISMATCH / CR-CHANGED-CONTENT verbatim. A frozen dataclass is explicitly NOT equated with immutable storage (docstring + test).

evaluate_duplicate_policy (§D): same canonical identity + different content -> ES-CONFLICTING-DUPLICATE; DELEGATES alias/near-copy to §9 detect_alias_or_nearcopy — surfacing CR-ALIAS-SAME-CONTENT / CR-NEAR-COPY-FROM-BUILD / CR-FABRICATED-OCI-DIGEST / CR-OCI-FROM-ACTIVE-IMPORT / CR-EMBEDDED-EVIDENCE verbatim. No silent canonicalisation / repair of aliases.

validate_upstream_binding (§E): binds to the EXACT upstream EV-04/EV-05 ProducerRegistrationRecords (real objects, NOT raw strings); DELEGATES each to producer_registration.validate_producer_registration (PR-FUT2-* verbatim) and evaluate_producer_registration_distinctness; rejects missing EV-04/EV-05 (ES-EV04-MISSING/ES-EV05-MISSING), stage!=4/5 (ES-UPSTREAM-LIFECYCLE-MISMATCH), ref mismatch (ES-EV04-REFERENCE-MISMATCH/ES-EV05-REFERENCE-MISMATCH), class mismatch (ES-EVIDENCE-CLASS-MISMATCH), shared registry authority (ES-REGISTRY-AUTHORITY-MISMATCH), wrong resolver contract (ES-RESOLVER-CONTRACT-MISMATCH), copied upstream reference (ES-COPIED-UPSTREAM-REFERENCE), expired/revoked upstream (ES-UPSTREAM-EXPIRED/ES-UPSTREAM-REVOKED), synthetic upstream in real mode (ES-SYNTHETIC-UPSTREAM-IN-REAL-MODE).

validate_producer_binding (§F): preserves producer-registration id / role / evidence class / storage binding; build vs OCI MUST stay distinct (DELEGATES distinctness); ES-PRODUCER-BINDING-BROKEN, ES-BUILD-OCI-NOT-DISTINCT. content_level_separation_status() -> CONTENT_LEVEL_SEPARATION_PREPARED_NOT_OPERATIONALLY_PROVEN.

validate_evidence_reference (§6): a reference is a POINTER governed by §9, not evidence; rejects inline JSON/Base64/PEM/compressed/control-chars/path-traversal/encoded-traversal/local-path/file://-URI/shell-fragment/embedded-credential/raw-dict/digest-only-string/mutable-query/alias/non-canonical -> ES-REFERENCE-IS-INLINE-PAYLOAD / ES-REFERENCE-NONCANONICAL / ES-REFERENCE-MUTABLE-QUERY / ES-REFERENCE-DIGEST-ONLY.

validate_evidence_store_readiness (main): composes §A/§B/§E/§F + the independent real-readiness gate + seal/digest/type/UTC/version/stage/revocation/provenance/ref-presence checks; () iff a valid SYNTHETIC EV-06 record.

_ModuleReadinessIssuer (ephemeral in-process HMAC, name-mangled key, no getter), _MODULE_ISSUER singleton, _READINESS_TOKEN module-private sentinel — mirroring FUT-1 _ReadinessIssuer / FUT-2 _ModuleRegistrationIssuer.

production_evidence_store_configured() (False) and configured_store_authority_identity() (None) — the module-controlled real-readiness root; ready_evidence_store(mode=REAL_CANDIDATE) always fails closed; new_synthetic_readiness / new_synthetic_evidence_store_readiness are token-gated SYNTHETIC-only mints.
what_not_implemented: NO real evidence store is created; storage is TECHNOLOGY-NEUTRAL — no filesystem, SQL, Redis, Git, OCI registry, or object store is selected, opened, or written.
NO evidence object is stored; NO evidence write, NO SQL/Redis/filesystem/object-store write, NO network, NO credentials/endpoints/buckets/host-paths.
The §9 resolver is CONSUMED, not reimplemented — there is exactly ONE resolver; this module adds no second resolver.
Production resolution stays UNAVAILABLE and fails closed (§9 ProductionContentResolver ALWAYS raises ContentResolverUnavailable).
NO runtime is touched; the module is not imported by runtime; no I/O, subprocess, network, filesystem, or environment lookup is performed.
NO configuration VALUES in code — references / policy tokens only.
Content-level separation is PREPARED, NOT operationally proven.

production_unavailability.decisive_root: C-FUT3-STORE-SOLE-ROOT: the real-readiness gate runs FIRST and requires production_evidence_store_configured()==True AND the record to resolve the module-controlled configured_store_authority_identity() (None here). The identity is a NON-Boolean second anchor so the Boolean can NEVER become the sole root: even with production_evidence_store_configured monkeypatched True, the configured identity is None -> ES-STORE-AUTHORITY-NOT-CONFIGURED -> no real record validates. A caller cannot supply this identity.
production_unavailability.local_seal_is_integrity_metadata_only: the _MODULE_ISSUER HMAC (readiness_seal) is LOCAL OBJECT-INTEGRITY METADATA ONLY — NOT a production trust root, NOT store authority, NOT external attestation, and NEVER by itself grounds real-mode acceptance.

synthetic_real_boundary.classification_setter: C-FUT3-READINESS-PROMOTION: the token-gated mint (new_synthetic_readiness / ready_evidence_store) is SYNTHETIC-ONLY and REJECTS any caller-selected non-synthetic classification with EvidenceStoreReadinessForbidden (not silently repaired).
synthetic_real_boundary.seal_binds_classification: the module seal covers readiness_digest + classification, so a relabel synthetic->'REAL' breaks the seal (ES-SEAL-INVALID)

disclosed_limitations: Opaque-reference: a governed reference is validated as a well-formed pointer (§6), NOT resolved to real content here — real resolution is §9's job and is unavailable in this WO.

Co-resident wholesale module replacement: a hostile in-process actor replacing the whole module (or the §9 module) is out of scope; supported + lightly-reflective paths fail closed (mirrors FUT-1/FUT-2).
prohibited_interpretations: This contract does NOT claim operational immutability, real durability, live resolution, live comparison, retention or recovery, or operational store availability.
SYNTHETIC_UNREADY minted here is test-only; it never certifies a real evidence store or a real resolver.
The module seal is NOT store authority; it is an ephemeral in-process integrity seal.
No output of this contract authorises store mutation, evidence writes, execution, publication, deployment, or any runtime change.
Content-level separation is PREPARED, NOT operationally proven.
acceptance_tests: DECISIVE: a reflectively-forged, correctly-sealed REAL readiness record validated in real_mode with production_evidence_store_configured monkeypatched True is STILL rejected ES-STORE-AUTHORITY-NOT-CONFIGURED (Boolean not sole root, seal not sole root); configured_store_authority_identity() is None.

Resolver readiness DELEGATES to §9 require_content_resolver; caller-provided resolver -> CR-RESOLVER-UNTRUSTED; synthetic in real mode -> CR-SYNTHETIC-IN-REAL-MODE; production resolver -> CR-UNRESOLVED-REFERENCE / ContentResolverUnavailable fail closed.

Immutability DELEGATES to §9 resolve_and_verify: mutable reference -> CR-MUTABLE-REFERENCE; changed content -> CR-CHANGED-CONTENT; reference/content mismatch -> CR-REFERENCE-CONTENT-MISMATCH; a frozen dataclass is NOT equated with immutable storage.
Duplicate/alias DELEGATES to §9 detect_alias_or_nearcopy: same content under alternate reference -> CR-ALIAS-SAME-CONTENT; same identity + different content -> ES-CONFLICTING-DUPLICATE.
Upstream EV-04/EV-05 consumed as real ProducerRegistrationRecords; missing/copied/revoked/expired/synthetic-in-real-mode rejected; lifecycle/class/authority/resolver-contract mismatches rejected.
§6 reference boundary rejects traversal / encoded traversal / control chars / inline JSON / Base64 / PEM / local path / file:// / URI credential / mutable query / digest-only string.

Inertness: module performs no open()/os.environ/getenv/socket/subprocess/requests/urllib/pathlib/sqlite/redis and no import-time I/O; secret-scan module + JSON + MD; no evidence/SQL/Redis/FS/object-store write, no credentials.

Positive: a fully-valid SYNTHETIC EV-06 readiness (trusted synthetic resolver, valid EV-04+EV-05 distinct, sha256, immutable_storage_id + storage_version present, independent) validates in TEST_ONLY; the SAME under REAL_CANDIDATE / real_mode rejects.
